text: Psst! Keep your voice down! That goblin is right over there, just a few steps away...
responses: Don't worry, I'll deal with it.
It's not that close. You're overreacting.

children.text: Really? You'd do that? Thank you! Just... please be careful. It looks really strong.
Overreacting?! It's only three tiles away from here! I've been stuck standing here for days...
